//: LibreLane config for the digital half of the mixed-signal tile.
This hardens ms_hello into a small standalone macro (GDS + LEF) which
analog/layout/build_gds.py then instantiates inside the analog tile.
Absolute die: the macro has to fit in the empty upper half of the tile,
clear of the analog core, the TopMetal1 power stripes and the ua routing.
All pins on the north edge: the tile routes down to them from the
Metal4 interface stubs along the top of the tile.
Leave Metal4 to the PDN and to tile-level routing; signals stop at Metal3.
Rails on Metal1 plus vertical Metal4 straps, no horizontal layer and no
core ring. The tile connects those straps to its own TopMetal1 stripes.
